text:
ravi: Heads-up: after toggling the ws keepalive optimization in the canary, a cohort of long-lived WS clients hit a weird half-close -> immediate reconnect loop and we saw duplicate quota checks. console alert: ALRT-4821. anyone digging? :thinking:

zoe: I see ALRT-4821. p95 reconnects + quota.recheck spikes for region eu-north. link: https://console.redwood/api/alerts/ALRT-4821

ravi: logs (sanitized):
```
2026-04-02T09:12:10Z INFO ws-halfclose client=acct-47 conn=tx12 keepalive=sent
2026-04-02T09:12:11Z WARN client-quick-reconnect client=acct-47 reason=halfclose
2026-04-02T09:12:11Z INFO quota.recheck client=acct-47 request=resume token=rt-9a
2026-04-02T09:12:12Z INFO billed tokens=33 client=acct-47
```

pat: sounds like client saw a TCP FIN and reconnected before the proxy propagated the new affinity header -> new shard treated it as fresh session and quota service did a full re-eval/bill. We also have reconnect sampling at 0.005 so console didn't flag the pattern until billing metrics spiked.

zoe: proposed mitigations: 1) introduce `ws-halfclose-grace=10s` where we accept quick reconnects as the same session if resume_token matches 2) temporary bump `reconnect.sample_frac` to 0.2 for eu-* for 15m to get better traces 3) add a per-shard quota.duplicate metric to the rollout dashboard.

ravi: I like the grace window. it's surgical and low-risk. billing dedupe suggestion: add a cheap cache in billing keyed by resume_token+client_hash with ttl=5s to ignore near-duplicate charges. seems safe.

pat: UX note: sampling controls are hidden under advanced -> telemetry. product-console, can we put a prominent sampling toggle on the rollback/rollout page? we keep running into the blindspot.

product-console: ack. we can add a small CTA and default suggestion for route-sensitive rollouts. will prioritize a small change.

inq-bot: [automated] ALRT-4821 acknowledged by ravi. Created incident INC-9017.

zoe: action list: ravi enable ws-halfclose-grace=10s on canary, zoe bump reconnect.sample_frac eu->0.2 for 15m, pat add billing-dedupe RFC (5s), product-console add rollout sampling CTA.

ravi: activating grace window now. watching metrics. if duplicate billing doesn't fall within 8m we rollback the keepalive change on the canary.

pat: quick data point from initial query: duplicate-quota rate peaked at T+2m and aligns with the halfclose events. original shard CPU climbed ~11%.

ravi: thanks. monitoring. :thumbsup:
